methodology.base: V18+ no-limit rerun with all one-year enriched pullback score buckets included. The avoid_score4/climax filter is intentionally removed.
kept: one-year enriched pullback signal pool from enrich_trades()
next-open entry with existing 2% discount condition enforced by V17 replay()
V18 fee/tax model and +0.10% adverse slippage each side
no finite capital, no max positions, no max-new-per-day, no duplicate-stock capacity filter
methodology.changed_from_v18_no_limit: Removed avoid_score4 / climax-score candidate filter so every original score bucket from the one-year pullback pool can enter if it passes replay/entry requirements.
methodology.warning: This is a broader diagnostic pool, not the frozen finite-capital V18 strategy.
